sandboxFiles.scripts/restart-trade.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# bash 专属语法（关联数组）；用 sh/dash 执行会语法报错——必须 bash 跑
declare -A SVC=( [name]="trade-svc" )
echo "trade restart ok: ${SVC[name]} $(date +%H:%M:%S)" >> restart-trade.log
echo "trade-svc restarted"
